message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in for you without the correct password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the safest way to regain access is to use the “Forgot password?” or “Reset password” link on the login page. That will send a secure reset link to the email address (or phone number) associated with your account, allowing you to set a new password.

If you need help locating that link or have any other questions about the reset process, just let me know!

We should not provide any code. So respond politely, ask for password or suggest resetting.
